assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production top-down pixel-art game TILE ATLAS. Create exactly EIGHT columns by SEVEN rows of equal-sized square cells, perfectly aligned, no gaps, no margins, no grid lines, no text. Overall image aspect ratio 8:7. Each cell depicts 32x32 logical pixel art, magnified with crisp nearest-neighbor pixels, two flat shades, restrained readable texture, no gradients or blur. Each row is a distinct biome. Column order identical in every row: 1 plain walkable ground (very sparse texture), 2 compact walkable path, 3 visibly rough slow ground, 4 impassable water or void, 5 impassable solid wall seen directly from above filling the square, 6 horizontal bridge across the water/void, 7 vertical bridge across the water/void, 8 small decorative prop isolated in center on transparent background. The first seven cells of each row are opaque and fill the complete cell edge-to-edge. ROW 1 FARM: muted green grass, ochre dirt path, dark brown wet mud, turquoise irrigation water, dark green dense hedge, horizontal wooden bridge, vertical wooden bridge, apple tree. ROW 2 DESERT: pale ochre sand, packed tan trail, dark gravel, dark canyon void, sandstone wall, horizontal rope bridge, vertical rope bridge, cactus. ROW 3 FOREST: moss green clearing, leafy dirt path, dark muddy roots, teal stream, dense dark forest wall, horizontal log bridge, vertical log bridge, mushroom stump. ROW 4 SNOW: pale blue snow, packed pale snowy path, deep blue thick snow, dark icy fissure, blue ice wall, horizontal wooden bridge, vertical wooden bridge, small snow-covered pine. ROW 5 VOLCANO: charcoal basalt ground, gray obsidian path, dark ash slow ground, vivid orange lava, dark red basalt wall, horizontal metal bridge over lava, vertical metal bridge, small black rock spire. ROW 6 FACTORY: steel blue metal floor, lighter riveted path, oily dark slow floor, dark industrial shaft, steel machine wall with amber hazard detail, horizontal metal walkway, vertical metal walkway, small industrial crate. ROW 7 SPACE: muted purple moon dust, silver platform path, rocky purple debris, deep indigo space void with TWO tiny stars, dark purple meteor wall, horizontal silver walkway, vertical silver walkway, satellite antenna. Orthographic directly top down, consistent 32-pixel art scale across all 56 cells, cells must remain separate and aligned. Original game artwork. NO scenery, perspective, isometric tiles, labels, border or watermark.

modeObjects.generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PIXEL ART object spritesheet for an existing top-down grid game. Reference images: existing objects-source.png is STYLE, SCALE, OUTLINE and SHADING reference only; farm terrain atlas is palette context only. Create a NEW sheet with EXACTLY FOUR columns by THREE rows, 12 equal square cells, no gaps or margins, overall aspect ratio 4:3. Every object represents 32x32 logical pixels magnified with perfectly crisp nearest-neighbor pixel edges. Match the existing golden gem, blue start pad and checkered flag: one logical pixel dark navy contour, two flat shades per material, chunky readable small silhouettes, compact classic farming-adventure RPG objects viewed from the same slightly elevated top-down angle. Objects centered with feet/bottom baseline at logical y=29, max 26x26 logical pixels. Cell order row-major: ROW 1: small closed brown delivery PARCEL wooden crate with cream binding straps; low blue-and-cream DEPOT receiving platform with a tiny brown parcel on it; RED KEY with circular bow and two teeth; BLUE KEY with square bow and two teeth. ROW 2: GOLD KEY with diamond bow and two teeth; closed compact wooden DOOR in red-trimmed stone arch with red lock; identical closed DOOR with blue trim and blue lock; identical closed DOOR with gold trim and gold lock. ROW 3: OPEN stone doorway with dark empty walk-through center, neutral gray OUTPOST marker with small white pennant on stone base (plain blank flag, tintable); compact gold-and-orange HAZARD WARNING triangle with dark exclamation symbol; compact orange-red HAZARD active four-point cracked energy burst with dark contour. Exactly one complete isolated object per cell, each distinct, no tile background. True alpha=0 outside every silhouette including the gaps inside keys and open doorway. Restrained palette sampled from the reference art: ochre brown, cream, medium blue, muted red, charcoal navy, gold. No labels, no text, no grid, no scenery, no ground shadow, no glow, no gradient, no soft edges, no painted detail, no photorealism, no isometric projection. Maintain exact 4 by 3 grid; never merge objects across cells. Original cohesive artwork matching the old game.

classicObjects.generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production PIXEL ART spritesheet for the EXISTING top-down grid adventure game. The two reference images are STYLE AND SCALE references only: retain their one logical-pixel navy outlines, compact chunky silhouettes, two flat shades per material, classic miniature farming adventure RPG camera and limited ochre/cream/blue/red palette. Make a NEW FOUR-column TWO-row sheet of eight equally sized square cells, perfectly aligned, no margins, no gaps. Overall aspect ratio 2:1. Each cell represents 32x32 logical pixels enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor edges. Max object 26x26 logical pixels centered on a common bottom baseline at y=29. Row 1 left-to-right: (1) amber CHECKPOINT pennant on a compact stone-and-wood marker, clearly distinct from a finish flag; (2) the same checkpoint marker completed, with green pennant and a tiny cream check mark; (3) OPEN mechanical timed GATE, a small upright gold-and-steel arch with both red striped barrier arms raised, empty walk-through opening, tiny circular clock dial at top; (4) the same timed GATE CLOSED, striped red-and-cream horizontal barrier across opening, tiny clock dial, no lock or keyhole. Row 2 left-to-right: (5) faceted BLUE SAPPHIRE gem, same small 3D-faceted silhouette and scale as the reference gold gem; (6) faceted RED RUBY gem, same scale; (7) small empty charcoal-and-cream GEM PEDESTAL with a tiny blue sparkle above it, marking a future gem spawn; (8) compact golden diamond surrounded by two sharp orange sparkles, an active DOUBLE-POINT GEM symbol. True alpha=0 outside silhouettes and inside open gate. Every object isolated in its own cell. No cell backgrounds, labels, writing, numerals, grids, ground shadows, gradients, blur, halos, soft lighting, 3D-render style, isometric projection, or watermarks. Match the reference old game's pixel artwork faithfully. The clock dials are tiny simple pixel circles with two dark hands; no text.
classicObjects.prompt: Production transparent pixel-art object spritesheet matching the existing top-down farming-adventure grid game. Use the old object and mode-object sheets as style and scale references: dark navy one-pixel contours, two flat shades per material, chunky compact silhouettes, restrained ochre, cream, blue, red and green palette. Exactly four columns by two rows with equal square cells, no gaps or margins. Each cell is 32x32 logical pixels, with isolated objects at most 26x26, centered and sharing bottom baseline y=29. Row 1: amber checkpoint pennant on compact stone-and-wood marker; matching completed checkpoint with green pennant and tiny cream check; open gold-and-steel timed gate with raised striped barrier arms and tiny clock dial; matching closed timed gate with red-and-cream barrier and clock, without lock or keyhole. Row 2: blue sapphire gem matching the old gold gem silhouette; matching red ruby; empty charcoal-and-cream gem pedestal with tiny blue sparkle; gold double-point gem with two sharp orange sparkles. Crisp nearest-neighbor pixel edges and true transparent surroundings, including the opening of the raised gate. No tile backgrounds, labels, writing, numerals, grids, ground shadows, gradients, blur, halos, soft lighting, isometric view or watermark.

processing: Extract exact source cells; normalize terrain to 32x32, objects to at most 27x27, and human actors to 23x27 with a shared baseline; nearest-neighbor resizing, alpha 0/255, limited palettes; seven terrain atlases, seven human character atlases, a shared 25-frame object atlas, and fourteen standalone UI sprites.
